description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No.03 of 2017 of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the enactment of an Appropriation Statute (No. 03 of 2017) by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, which amends previous appropriation statutes. It involves legal/regulatory matters concerning provincial financial legislation and amendments to existing laws, falling clearly under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5).
